records.//: No write on the collection itself, only on a record inside it. That is what stops one call from deleting the whole service history: a wipe would have to be 69 separate deletes, not a single PUT of null. The app never writes here anyway — it updates records/<id> paths.

people.//: The people list may be replaced wholesale — it is small, rebuilt from each device, and losing it costs a few names rather than a year of inspections.
